7b74f4ed: ;
This routine prints a variety of patient reports based on
options selected.
;
It has the following flow:
1. If DIVISION^VAUTOMA is required it is called
2. The type of report (DGJTL) is determined
3. Additional options are retrieved based on DGJTL
4. Output device is determined
5. START label begins the report processing
